mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let's take a moment to really let these ideas sink in. Education isn't just about grades or diplomas—it's a journey where you discover who you are. Sometimes, the people closest to us—our families—can give us roots and love, but they might also hold us back, even if they mean well. Facing hard truths? Yeah, it hurts. But it’s the only way to start healing and to live in a way that feels real. Belonging doesn't come from trying to fit in or pretending to be someone else. It comes from being brave enough to show up as yourself, even when it’s tough. And while your past definitely shapes you, it doesn’t have to decide your future. The story of “Educated” is about so much more than just leaving home or getting degrees. It’s about that quiet, stubborn work of becoming who you truly are. It’s about opening your eyes to new possibilities, questioning things you once took for granted, and discovering meaning in both your struggles and your hopes. If you ever feel caught between worlds, or wonder where you fit in, just remember—you’re not alone. Growth isn’t easy. Sometimes, it costs more than you expect. But every step you take—every time you’re honest and every time you’re brave—brings you closer to living a life that’s yours. Believe that your story matters. Your questions are worth asking. And the journey toward understanding is always worth it. The world is bigger than you think, and your place in it is out there, waiting for you to step in.
